privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains what Quran Circles collects about you, why, who can see it, and how to have it deleted. We have kept it short and plain.
privacy.who.heading: Who we are
privacy.who.body: Quran Circles (the Android app pk.doraquran.circles and the website qurancircle.doraquran.pk) is run by Tanzeem-e-Islami (“we”). It helps people find and join Quran study circles at masjids in Pakistan.
privacy.noaccount.heading: You can start without an account
privacy.noaccount.body: You can find circles, read the Quran and see prayer times without signing in. We ask for personal details only when you sign in or join a circle.
privacy.collect.heading: What we collect
privacy.collect.intro: When you sign in or join a circle, we collect:
privacy.collect.phone: Your mobile number. You sign in with it. We send a one-time code to it on WhatsApp, or by SMS if WhatsApp cannot deliver it, to check that the number is yours.
privacy.collect.name: Your name, as you type it when you first join a circle.
privacy.collect.area: Your area (a neighbourhood from our list of places) and your section (women, men or family), which you choose when you join.
privacy.collect.joins: Your joins: the circles you pledge to join, the date, and whether you later cancel.
privacy.collect.follows: The masjids and circles you follow, and your choices about reminders and messages, with when you made them.
privacy.collect.profile: Details you add to your profile, only if you choose to: age group, profession, education, how much Quran you have read before, your language and a daily reading goal.
privacy.collect.reading: Your reading, if you are signed in: your place in the Quran, bookmarks and their notes, the days you read and how many pages or ayahs, and the surahs you mark as memorised with the date you last revised them.
privacy.collect.device: Your device’s push address (a token from Google Firebase Cloud Messaging on Android, or from your browser on the web), the device type and your language, so we can send reminders and the ayah of the day.
privacy.collect.signin: Sign-in records: a session for each device (a scrambled copy of its key, the device name and when it was last used) and, with each code request, a scrambled one-way copy of your internet address that we use only to stop abuse.
privacy.collect.attendance: If you attend a circle, its coordinator may note a headcount, and sometimes a name, on an attendance list.
privacy.not.heading: What we do not collect
privacy.not.location: Your location. The Android app does not ask for it. On the web, if you press “Use my location” on the map, your browser asks first, and the position only centres the map on your own screen; it is never sent to us or saved. To show circles near you, we use the area you picked.
privacy.not.device: Your contacts, photos, files, camera or microphone.
privacy.not.ads: Anything for advertising. There are no ads, no advertising ids and no advertising or analytics trackers, and we never sell or rent your information.
privacy.use.heading: How we use it
privacy.use.signin: To sign you in and keep you signed in.
privacy.use.join: To record your pledge to join a circle, so its coordinator knows who plans to come.
privacy.use.messages: To send a confirmation, a reminder before each session, and word of any change or cancellation.
privacy.use.ayah: To send the ayah of the day, unless you turn it off.
privacy.use.reading: To save your reading and bookmarks so they follow you to another device.
privacy.use.safe: To keep the service safe, and to count things without names, such as how many people joined a circle or read together in a day.
privacy.messages.heading: Messages
privacy.messages.body: We use WhatsApp only for sign-in codes, confirmations, important changes and, where push does not reach you, reminders. We check that you agreed first, and we send no advertising. You can switch reminders and the ayah of the day off in your profile at any time.
privacy.sees.heading: Who can see your information
privacy.sees.coordinators: Coordinators. The coordinators of a circle you join, and the city and national team, can see your name, mobile number, section and joining status for that circle. They use it to run the circle and to contact you about it.
privacy.sees.providers: Service providers, who handle information for us and only for that purpose:
privacy.sees.meta: Meta (WhatsApp Business), which delivers WhatsApp messages and so sees your number and the message.
privacy.sees.sms: A text-message (SMS) provider, which delivers a sign-in code by SMS when WhatsApp cannot, and so sees your number and the code message.
privacy.sees.google: Google, for push messages on Android (Firebase Cloud Messaging) and for maps (Google Maps), which receive your push token or the map requests and your internet address. On the web the map may use OpenStreetMap tiles instead.
privacy.sees.browser: Your browser’s push service, if you turn on notifications on the web.
privacy.sees.quran: api.alquran.cloud, where the Quran text is loaded from. It sees your internet address and which part of the Quran is asked for, not who you are.
privacy.sees.hosting: Our hosting provider and Cloudflare, which carry the traffic to our servers and so see your internet address.
privacy.sees.nobody: No one else. We do not sell, rent or share your information for advertising. We may disclose it if the law requires.
privacy.keep.heading: How long we keep it
privacy.keep.account: Your account details and everything tied to them stay until you delete your account.
privacy.keep.codes: Sign-in codes are removed about a day after they expire. Finished sign-in sessions are removed 30 days after they end.
privacy.keep.deleted: When you delete your account, your personal information is removed at once. What stays is listed on the delete page, and it holds no name or number.
privacy.keep.backups: Our database is backed up in encrypted copies kept for up to 14 days (daily) and 8 weeks (weekly). Deleted information can remain in those copies until they expire.
privacy.choices.heading: Your choices
privacy.choices.edit: Change your name and details in your profile.
privacy.choices.notify: Turn reminders and the ayah of the day on or off in your profile.
privacy.choices.signout: Sign out of a device in your profile.
privacy.choices.delete: Delete your account and personal information, in the app or from the delete page.
privacy.choices.ask: Ask us by email what we hold about you, or to correct it.
privacy.safe.heading: Keeping it safe
privacy.safe.body: Everything travels over encrypted connections (HTTPS). Sign-in codes and keys are stored only as scrambled copies. Personal details are visible only to coordinators for their own circles and a small national team, and their actions are logged. Backups are encrypted. No system is perfectly safe, so please tell us if you see a problem.
privacy.children.heading: Children
privacy.children.body: Quran Circles is not made for children under 13 and we do not knowingly collect their information. If you think a child has given us their details, write to us and we will delete them.
privacy.changes.heading: Changes to this policy
privacy.changes.body: If we change this policy we will change the date above and, if the change matters, tell you in the app.
deleteAccount.title: Delete your account and data
deleteAccount.intro: You can delete your Quran Circles account and the personal information in it at any time. This page says how, what is deleted and what is kept.
deleteAccount.before.heading: Before you delete
deleteAccount.before.body: Deleting cannot be undone. If you only want fewer messages, you can switch reminders off in your profile, or sign out, instead.
deleteAccount.app.heading: In the app
deleteAccount.app.step1: Open Quran Circles and sign in with your mobile number.
deleteAccount.app.step2: Open your profile (the person icon at the top of the Home screen).
deleteAccount.app.step4: Confirm. Your account is deleted at once and you are signed out.
deleteAccount.web.heading: Without the app
deleteAccount.web.intro: If you have uninstalled the app, you can do the same on the web:
deleteAccount.web.step2: Sign in with the mobile number of your account. We send a code on WhatsApp.
deleteAccount.web.step3: Open your profile, tap “Delete my account” and confirm.
deleteAccount.request.heading: If you cannot sign in
deleteAccount.request.body: Email us and ask us to delete your account. Give the mobile number on the account. Before we delete anything we send a code to that number on WhatsApp, to make sure the request is from you. We aim to finish within 30 days.
deleteAccount.deleted.heading: What is deleted
deleteAccount.deleted.profile: Your mobile number, name, area and profile details.
deleteAccount.deleted.settings: The circles and masjids you follow, your reminder and message choices, your push addresses, and your sign-in sessions on every device.
deleteAccount.deleted.reading: Your bookmarks and notes, reading place, reading days, and memorised surahs.
deleteAccount.deleted.requests: Your requests for a circle in your area and your read marks in the updates feed.
deleteAccount.deleted.messages: Messages waiting to be sent to you, and the number and text of messages already sent to you.
deleteAccount.deleted.codes: Sign-in codes and invitations for your number, and any record from the 2026 Ramadan Dora (the earlier version of the site) that holds your name and number.
deleteAccount.deleted.roles: If you were a coordinator or admin, your access ends too.
deleteAccount.kept.heading: What is kept
deleteAccount.kept.joins: Your past joins stay as counts with no name or number, so a circle’s numbers do not change. Any name a coordinator typed for you on an attendance list is cleared.
deleteAccount.kept.totals: The national “read together” totals, which never held your name.
deleteAccount.kept.records: A record that a message was sent, with its status and cost, but without the number or text.
deleteAccount.kept.audit: If you were a coordinator, the record that an action was taken stays, but it no longer names you.
deleteAccount.kept.backups: Encrypted backups, for up to 8 weeks, until they expire.
support.title: Help and contact
support.intro: Write to us and we will do our best to help. These answers may save you the wait.
support.faq.heading: Common questions
support.faq.code.q: I did not get my sign-in code
support.faq.code.a: The code arrives on WhatsApp, or by SMS if WhatsApp cannot deliver it. Check that you typed your Pakistani mobile number correctly and that WhatsApp is on the phone with that number. Wait a few minutes before asking for another code; too many requests are paused for a while.
support.faq.name.q: How do I change my name?
support.faq.name.a: Open your profile, change your name and tap Save.
support.faq.alerts.q: How do I stop reminders or the ayah of the day?
support.faq.alerts.a: Open your profile and switch off what you do not want.
support.faq.wrong.q: The time or place of a circle is wrong
support.faq.wrong.a: The circle’s coordinator keeps its details. The circle’s page shows how to reach the masjid. You can also write to us with the circle’s name and we will pass it on.
support.faq.delete.q: How do I delete my account?
support.faq.delete.a: Follow the steps on the delete page.
support.report.heading: Report a problem
support.report.body: Tell us what you were doing, what you expected and what happened. Add the app version, which is at the bottom of your profile, and your phone model. Never send a sign-in code.
terms.title: Terms of use
terms.intro: By using Quran Circles you agree to these terms. They are short on purpose.
terms.use.heading: Using Quran Circles
terms.use.body: Quran Circles is free. Use it to find and join Quran study circles, to read, and to keep your own progress. Please use it kindly and truthfully.
terms.account.heading: Your account
terms.account.body: Your account belongs to your mobile number. Keep your phone safe and do not share your sign-in codes. Give your real name when you join a circle, so its coordinator knows who to expect.
terms.join.heading: Joining a circle
terms.join.body: Joining is a pledge to come, not a reserved seat. A circle can change its time or place or be cancelled, and we will tell you. Please cancel if you can no longer come.
terms.details.heading: Circle details
terms.details.body: Circles are run by coordinators and volunteers at masjids. If the details matter, check them with the masjid. Times are in Pakistan time.
terms.conduct.heading: Behaviour
terms.conduct.body: Do not misuse the service: no false registrations, no harassing other people or coordinators, no trying to break or overload it, and no automated bulk use. We may suspend an account that does.
terms.quran.heading: The Quran text
terms.quran.body: The Quran text and translations come from others and are credited in About and credits. We try to show them unchanged, but please check against a printed copy for anything important.
terms.service.heading: The service
terms.service.body: We try to keep Quran Circles running, but we cannot promise it will always work or be free of mistakes. We may change or stop features. To the extent the law allows, we are not responsible for loss from using it, including from a circle that changed or was cancelled.
terms.privacy.heading: Your information
terms.privacy.body: How we handle your information is in the privacy policy.
terms.changes.heading: Changes and law
terms.changes.body: We may update these terms and will change the date above. If you keep using Quran Circles after that, you accept the new terms. These terms are governed by the laws of Pakistan.
signIn.email.intro: Enter your email address. We will send you a 6-digit code.
signIn.email.label: Email address
signIn.problem.email: Enter a valid email address, such as name@example.com.
signIn.problem.noAccount: We could not find an account for this email. Create one to continue.
signUp.email.label: Email address
signUp.email.hint: We will send your sign-in code here.
signUp.problem.phone: Enter your WhatsApp number with the country code, such as 0300 1234567 or +44 7700 900123.
